title: test_tls13_integration name implies TLS handshake but test only exercises crypto primitives
description: crypto2dev_test.c test_tls13_integration() creates a TLS 1.3 CTX, assigns devId, then exercises SHA-256, HMAC, and AES-GCM individually. No actual TLS handshake is performed. A contributor reading the test name will expect a real handshake test and be confused. Rename to test_tls13_devid_and_primitives() or restructure the comment header to make clear the scope is 'TLS-safe mode + individual primitive KATs'.
